Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma (Dabska tumor) does not match the clinical and histological features described in the vignette.

The clinical and histological features described in the vignette, such as the asymptomatic, reddish hematomalike plaque with a brownish peripheral border, poorly defined vascular proliferation, and presence of hemosiderin deposits, are consistent with benign lymphangioendothelioma (BLAE), which is also known as targetoid hemosiderotic hemangioma.
